name: C-5M Super Galaxy
summary: The largest aircraft in the US military: a four-engine strategic airlifter with nose and tail loading for outsize cargo.

wings: High-mounted swept wing with marked droop (anhedral)
engines: Four large high-bypass turbofans on pylons under the wing
fuselage: Extremely long fuselage with a raised upper deck
Large rounded nose that hinges upward as a visor for front loading
Many-wheeled landing gear in sponsons along the lower fuselage
tail: T-tail: very tall swept fin with the horizontal tail on top

tellTales: Huge high-winged four-jet transport with a T-tail and no winglets
Very long fuselage ending in a large rounded nose
Wings that droop noticeably toward the tips

confusedWith.howToTell: The C-5 is much longer with a rounded visor nose and no winglets; the C-17 is shorter and stockier with upturned winglets.
The C-5 has a high wing and a T-tail; the 747 has a low wing, a conventional tail and an upper-deck hump only at the front.

usCount.source: USAF C-5M Super Galaxy fact sheet
